newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso firmer on fund flows to Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso firmer on fund flows to Mexico.

text.p: The Mexican peso extended its early advance to reach its strongest level in weeks against the dollar at mid-morning trade on Friday due to a continuing inflow of foreign capital, dealers said.
"There's got to be real capital inflow as the market is awash with dollars," a trader said, adding that selling dollars to go short would not be sufficient by itself to explain current peso strength.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were 2.1 and 1.6 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.8510/7.8540 and 7.8480/7.8510 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 3.15 centavos firmer at 7.8390/7.8425 per dollar.
Dealers said some players took advanateg of the epso's strongest levels since April 24 to exercise dollar put auctions previously auction byt he central bank.
